newsitem.title: FRANCE: Europeans probe Kurdish charges against Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Europeans probe Kurdish charges against Turkey.

text.p: Members of the European Commission of Human Rights are carrying out a rare investigation in Turkey of three complaints submitted by Kurds, the commission said on Wednesday.
Two of the complaints deal with the disappearance of two people and the death of a third which the Kurdish plaintiffs blame on Turkish security forces.
The third covers the destruction of a house which the plaintiffs blame on security forces but which Ankara blames on Kurdish PKK guerrillas.
More than 24,000 lives have been lost in Turkey's struggle against the PKK which has been fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence since 1984.

The investigators will hear witnesses, magistrates and members of the security forces and report by the end of the month to the commission, which screens cases to be submitted to the European Court of Human Rights in the eastern French city of Strasbourg.
